mentions.name: AI NeXTStep decompiler
mentions.description: This project uses AI to decompile NeXTStep applications back into Objective-C source code. The goal is to recover legacy applications such as WordPerfect or Framemaker and port their NeXTStep code to GNUStep so they can run on Linux.
mentions.problem: Legacy NeXTStep applications like WordPerfect or Framemaker only exist as binaries and are unavailable on GNUStep/Linux without recovering their source code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm using AI to de-compile NeXTStep applications back to Objective-C source code.

The idea is decompile something like Wordperfect or Framemaker, then port the NeXTStep code to GNUStep and have WP on GNUStep/Linux.
